findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous use of pickle/cPickle for deserialization
 * @description Detects uses of pickle or cPickle load/loads which may lead to code execution if fed untrusted data.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pycparser/pickle-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("cPickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of pickle/cPickle deserialization; ensure inputs are trusted or use safer formats."
findings.hypothesis: Package uses pickle/cPickle for deserialization, which can be unsafe with untrusted data.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name pycparser unsafe pickle deserialization usage
 * @description Find pickle/cPickle load/loads usages in pycparser to assess CWE-502 risk.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pycparser/unsafe-pickle-detail
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().regexpMatch("^pycparser/ply/yacc.py$") and
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "pickle deserialization here; ensure only trusted grammar tables are loaded (CWE-502)."
findings.hypothesis: pickle deserialization in yacc.py may deserialize untrusted data (CWE-502).
